notes: Native firmware 0.1.38 — the finishing-write protection: after the last TFT block the display keeps writing its final flash pages INCLUDING the system data area; the fixed 6 s wait let the handshake's serial traffic interrupt that write and corrupt the system data (the display booted into System-Data-ERROR — the user's report; a power cycle does NOT clear it, the ledger correction is recorded). The code now waits for the display's OWN reboot announcement (the kit HMI's printh 88 ff ff ff, up to 30 s) before any serial, then handshakes. Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
